Archival Dispatch: 19 Master Broadcasts Dated Across Hank Williams, The Bickersons, Lou Holtz, and WW2 Wartime Bulletins

Date: 2026-08-21
Author: radio index
Reading: 4 min
Tags: Hank Williams, Mothers Best Flour, The Bickersons, Don Ameche, Frances Langford, Lou Holtz Laugh Club, Pearl Harbor, OWI Wartime Bulletins, Compact Classics, Lulu Belle and Scotty, Big D Jamboree, Original Filenames
Raw Markdown

Batch 78 Forensic Discoveries

Batch 78 recovers and dates 19 historical audio broadcasts spanning legendary country radio transcriptions, network marital squabbling comedy, vaudeville storytelling, World War II Office of War Information mobilization announcements and news bulletins, and literary masterworks: 2 rare 1951 morning broadcasts from Hank Williams on Mother's Best Flour (WSM Nashville), 3 classic insomnia battles from Don Ameche and Frances Langford on The Bickersons (1947), 3 vaudeville monologues from The Lou Holtz Laugh Club (1938), 4 World War II home-front mobilization announcements on WW2 Promos and Commercials (including the historic December 7, 1941 Pearl Harbor NBC newsflash, fat salvage, and wartime travel warnings), 4 educational adaptations from Compact Classics (Moby Dick, Treasure Island, The Old Man and the Sea, and Reader's Choice Treasury), 2 mountain music broadcasts from Lulu Belle and Scotty on Breakfast in the Blue Ridge (1945), and a live Dallas Sportatorium performance on Big 'D' Jamboree (1954).
